description: Make a pixel-art game character sprite sheet from named parts drawn by code: pick hair, eyes, outfit, hat, weapon and colours that fit what the user described, and the GameShipKit Pixel Character Maker draws idle, walk, attack, jump, hurt and die frames in 4 directions (front, right, left, back) or side view. Returns the PNG sheet, the column layout and a link to the editor. Colours are hex codes; the nearest colour of the maker's palette is used. Call again with the same parts to change one thing.

animations.description: Animations in the sheet, left to right. Frames: idle 2, walk 4, attack 3, jump 3, hurt 2, die 4, run 4, cast 3, interact 3, sit 1. Default: idle, walk.

directions.description: 4dir: rows front, right, left, back (top-down RPG). side: one row facing right (platformer).

parts.description: Parts by name. Leave a part out for its default (or a random one with seed).

seed.description: Fill every part and colour you did not set at random, the same way for the same seed. Leave out to use plain defaults instead.

size.description: Frame size in pixels. This server draws up to 32 px; the local server (npx -y gameshipkit-mcp) and the editor link do every size.
